# Zone

`cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /zones/{zone_id}` |
| create | `POST /zones` |
| update | `PATCH /zones/{zone_id}` |
| delete | `DELETE /zones/{zone_id}` |

References: `accountRef` → Account / ClusterAccount.

Credentials: via account.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Zone
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    accountRef:
      name: <name>
    name: <name>
```

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.accountRef` | object |  | A reference to an object of kind `Account` (default) in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or of kind `ClusterAccount`, by `kind`. |
| `forProvider.accountRef.apiVersion` | string |  | `apiVersion` of the referenced object; needed when its kind is in several groups. |
| `forProvider.accountRef.kind` | string |  | One of `Account`, `ClusterAccount`. Default `Account`. |
| `forProvider.accountRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `forProvider.name` | string | yes | The domain name. Per [RFC 1035](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1035#section-2.3.4) the overall zone name can be up to 253 characters, with each segment ("label") not exceeding 63 characters. |
| `forProvider.paused` | boolean |  | Indicates whether the zone is only using Cloudflare DNS services. A true value means the zone will not receive security or performance benefits. |
| `forProvider.type` | string |  | A full zone implies that DNS is hosted with Cloudflare. A partial zone is typically a partner-hosted zone or a CNAME setup. One of `full`, `partial`, `secondary`, `internal`. |
| `forProvider.vanity_name_servers` | []string |  | An array of domains used for custom name servers. This is only available for Business and Enterprise plans. |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |

Validation:

- `forProvider`: name cannot be removed once set
- `forProvider.name`: name is immutable
